blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY – Two fishermen were rescued by the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) in the waters of Santa Ana, Cagayan on Wednesday. The fishing boat M/B Blue Marlin Hunter had been damaged by strong waves, prompting the fishers to issue distress calls. The PCG in Sta Ana deployed a team to save the two men, who ventured out to sea despite inclement weather. They were brought to the rural health unit for medical checkup and were found in good condition.
